# Shotsnap

> Node.js library that takes a screenshot of a website from its URL through a hosted cloud browser and returns the image as a Buffer.

Install with `npm i --save shotsnap`. `takeScreenshot({ pageUrl, saveFile, fileName, screenWidth, screenHeight })` returns a Promise of a Buffer. The screen defaults to 800x768, and with `saveFile: true` the image is written to `fileName` (default `shotsnap.png`). Every call goes to the public API at shotsnap.vercel.app, which can rate-limit heavy use.

## Docs

- [Home](https://halitsever.github.io/shotsnap/): overview
- [Getting Started](https://halitsever.github.io/shotsnap/get-started.html): installation and cloud browser limits
- [Taking Screenshot From A Website](https://halitsever.github.io/shotsnap/taking-screenshot.html): a full example and how the cloud browser works
- [Props](https://halitsever.github.io/shotsnap/props.html): pageUrl, saveFile, fileName, screenWidth and screenHeight
